name: input
title: Input
description: A single-line text input in Fluent's small, medium and large, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.

manifest.name: input
manifest.title: Input
manifest.description: A single-line text input in Fluent's small, medium and large, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.
manifest.usage: Put Input inside a Field with a FieldLabel (and FieldDescription and FieldError as needed); it takes the label, description and validity from it. Use Textarea for multi-line text and InputGroup for an icon, a unit or a button attached to the input. Match the size to the controls beside it. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Fluent's field appearance: outline (a light fill, a hairline and the darker bottom edge), underline (the bottom edge only), filled-darker (color.bg.inset) or filled-lighter (color.bg.surface).

props.name: size
props.description: Fluent's field sizes: 24, 32 and 40 px when comfortable (caption-1, body-1, body-2), 22, 28 and 34 px when compact (size.control.sm, md, lg).

props.name: size (sm, md, lg)
props.description: The old size names, mapped to small, medium and large. Kept for one release.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every change.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid outside a Field; inside a Field, data-invalid comes from its validation.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The input; data-slot="input" and data-appearance and data-size name it.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Invalid value: the danger hairline and bottom edge. Inside a Field the same style follows data-invalid.

states.name: invalid-in-field
states.description: Invalid inside a Base UI Field (its validation sets data-invalid).

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction, with Fluent's disabled stroke and text, no fill.

accessibility: Renders a native <input>; give it a visible <label> (or a Base UI Field.Label), or aria-label when there is no room for one.
Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface.
Mark errors with aria-invalid and point aria-describedby at the message; the danger hairline and bottom edge is not the only signal.
The bottom edge (color.border.control-bottom) meets 3:1 on every fill and surface a field takes, as WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's boundary; the hairline (color.border.subtle) is decoration.

meta.example:
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/field/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/input/input";

/** The smallest useful Input: a labelled text field. */
export function InputMinimal() {
  return <Input aria-label="Table name" placeholder="customers" />;
}

/**
 * A connection form: the four Fluent appearances, the three sizes, a hint, an invalid field with
 * its message, and a disabled field.
 */
export function InputRealistic() {
  return (
    <form className="flex flex-col gap-stack-md">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Host</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="host" defaultValue="db.internal" />
        <FieldDescription>A name or address on your network.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Port</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="port" size="small" defaultValue="99999" />
        <FieldError>The port must be between 1 and 65535.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Database</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="database" appearance="underline" placeholder="postgres" />
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>User</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="user" appearance="filled-darker" defaultValue="analyst" />
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Ghi chú</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="note" appearance="filled-lighter" size="large" defaultValue="Kết nối chỉ đọc cho báo cáo" />
      </Field>
      <Field disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Driver</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="driver" defaultValue="postgres" />
      </Field>
    </form>
  );
}
